import subprocess,tomllib,shlex,json
from pathlib import Path
h=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']['termux-phone']
key=Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser()
known=Path.home()/'.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1/adb_usb_known_hosts'
rows=subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25).stdout.splitlines()[1:]
usb=[r.split()[0] for r in rows if len(r.split())>=2 and r.split()[1]=='device' and ':' not in r.split()[0]]
assert len(usb)==1
f=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',usb[0],'forward','tcp:18122','tcp:8022'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
assert f.returncode==0
try:
 remote=r'''set -u
D="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux"
SVC="$PREFIX/var/service/photomap-dev"
printf 'SERVICE_LINK='; readlink "$SVC"
printf 'SERVICE_STATUS='; sv status "$SVC" || true
printf 'PROCESS_MATCH_BEGIN\n'
ps -A -o pid,ppid,stat,comm,args 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'photomap-dev|/mnt/server.py|proot-distro|proot|8010' | grep -v 'grep -E' | head -n 32 || true
printf 'PROCESS_MATCH_END\n'
printf 'LISTEN_8010_BEGIN\n'; ss -tlpn 2>/dev/null | grep ':8010' || true; printf 'LISTEN_8010_END\n'
printf 'DB_BYTES='; stat -c %s "$D/data/app.db"
printf 'BACKUP_EXISTS='; test -d "$D/rollback-prepi-20261101-v1" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'STAGE_DB='; test -f "$D/import-pi-20261101-v1/data/app.db" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'PHOTO_HTTP='; curl -sS -m 7 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8010/health
printf 'ILESTOI_HTTP='; curl -sS -m 7 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health/ready
'''
 args=['ssh','-i',str(key),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','UserKnownHostsFile='+str(known),'-o','ConnectTimeout=9','-p','18122',str(h['user'])+'@127.0.0.1','bash -c '+shlex.quote(remote)]
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=75)
 print(json.dumps({'rc':p.returncode,'out':p.stdout[-6000:],'err':p.stderr[-700:]},ensure_ascii=False))
finally:
 subprocess.run(['adb','-s',usb[0],'forward','--remove','tcp:18122'],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
